title: Kiba Arms inner grate door key

infobox.usage: Unlocks the inner grate door to the KIBA firearms store on Interchange.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Kiba Arms inner grate door key (KIBA inner) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the inner gate door of the KIBA Arms International outlet at the ULTRA shopping mall.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - This is the second of two keys required to enter the KIBA firearms store. The first one is the Kiba Arms outer door key.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quest Provocation

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Located on the first floor of the ULTRA shopping mall on Interchange, near the center of the mall.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
